items.title: Rob Mounsey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 9, 2025
items.q: I know John. I haven’t seen John in a while but I know him. Father and son are fabulous.

ctx.x: Were you familiar with some of the players like Bucky and Joe Wilder and — those guys from an earlier generation and go to a session where you arranged the music and there they are. And what did that feel like?

Great. It felt great. Joe Wilder I don’t know. I worked with Bucky exactly once and that was on a record Lyle Lovett’s remake of “The Summer Wind” produced by Russ Titelman again, and Bucky plays his — you know it’s sort of like a small big band and a live string section of all things, of only violins and violas. A small — it was supposed to kind of sound like a big band but it’s only about seven horns. And Bucky was just great. A great guy. But I think if you look up that record, Lyle Lovett, “Summer Wind”…
Do you have a, I’ll call it a backlog of available things you’ve written if some opportunity comes up, someone needs a theme?
